doc:
# Basic — Wilson Loops

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “Wilson loop holographic”).

claims.name: holographic_maldacenawilson_loop_analyzed_deformed
claims.statement: The holographic Maldacena--Wilson loop is analyzed in this deformed background.

sources.title: Wilson loop in a $T\bar{T}$ like deformed $\rm{CFT}_2$

claims.name: oneloop_determinant_fluctuation_modes_holographic
claims.statement: The one-loop determinant for fluctuation modes of a holographic Wilson loop in AdS4xCP3 is computed.

sources.title: One-loop corrections to holographic Wilson loop in AdS4xCP3

claims.name: holographic_thermalization_studied_through_twopoint
claims.statement: Holographic thermalization is studied through the two-point function, the Wilson loop and the holographic entanglement entropy.

sources.title: Holographic thermalization in Gauss-Bonnet gravity with de Sitter boundary

claims.name: nearhorizon_quantum_gravitational_fluctuations_significantly
claims.statement: Near-horizon quantum gravitational fluctuations significantly modify holographic Wilson loop expectation values.

sources.title: Quantum-Corrected Holographic Wilson Loop Expectation Values and Super-Yang-Mills Confinement

claims.name: using_holographic_prescription_wilson_loop
claims.statement: Using the holographic prescription, the Wilson loop is computed on the gravity side.

sources.title: RG Flow, Wilson Loops and the Dilaton Tadpole

claims.name: entanglement_entropy_wilson_loop_function
claims.statement: Entanglement entropy and Wilson loop function as probes of the holographic superconductor phase transition.

sources.title: Entanglement Entropy and Wilson Loop in Stückelberg Holographic Insulator/Superconductor Model

claims.name: results_used_probe_holographic_duality
claims.statement: The results are used to probe the holographic duality through exact Wilson-loop observables.

claims.name: effect_marginal_deformations_holographic_entanglement
claims.statement: The effect of these marginal deformations on holographic entanglement measures and the Wilson loop is studied.

sources.title: Non-local Probes in Holographic Theories with Momentum Relaxation

claims.name: derived_dilaton_potential_satisfies_standard
claims.statement: The derived dilaton potential satisfies standard IHQCD constraints and yields quark confinement in the holographic Wilson loop.

sources.title: Deriving dilaton potential in improved holographic QCD from meson spectrum

claims.name: finite_holographic_result_matches_corresponding
claims.statement: The finite holographic result matches the corresponding ratio of Wilson loop vevs on the gauge theory side.

claims.name: matrix_model_holographic_calculations_entanglement
claims.statement: The matrix model and holographic calculations of the entanglement entropy agree completely for these Wilson loop configurations.

sources.title: Entanglement entropy of Wilson loops: Holography and matrix models

claims.name: totally_symmetric_wilson_loop_new
claims.statement: For the totally symmetric Wilson loop, new contributions are found that improve agreement with the dual holographic computation at one-loop order in the appropriate regime.

sources.title: Comments on Higher Rank Wilson Loops in ${\cal N}=2^*$

claims.name: phase_structures_shown_equaltime_twoheavyoperator
claims.statement: Phase structures shown by equal-time two-heavy-operator correlation function are consistent with holographic entanglement entropy and Wilson loop.

sources.title: Holographic Van der Waals-like phase transition in the Gauss-Bonnet gravity

claims.name: supersymmetric_brane_configuration_determines_holographic
claims.statement: A supersymmetric M2-brane configuration determines the holographic dual of a BPS Wilson loop for a Hopf circle in $S^3$.

sources.title: Wilson loops and the geometry of matrix models in AdS_4/CFT_3

claims.name: moduli_space_generic_double_concentric
claims.statement: The moduli space of a generic double concentric Wilson loop features circles separated in the holographic direction of the confining background.

sources.title: Holographic meson decays via worldsheet instantons

claims.name: gauss_bonnet_corrections_entanglement_entropy
claims.statement: Gauss–Bonnet corrections to entanglement entropy, $n$-partite information, and Wilson loop are analyzed in a holographic model with momentum relaxation.

sources.title: Higher-curvature Corrections to Holographic Entanglement with Momentum Dissipation

claims.name: first_exact_matching_overall_numerical
claims.statement: This is the first exact matching of the overall numerical prefactor in a Wilson loop expectation value against the dual holographic result.

sources.title: Wilson loops at large $N$ and the quantum M2 brane

claims.name: holographic_dual_description_wilson_loop
claims.statement: The holographic dual description of a Wilson loop is a fundamental string embedded in asymptotically AdS spaces, at zero and nonzero temperature.

sources.title: Holographic RG flow and reparametrization invariance of Wilson Loops
